file_list_assertion: 15 K27R time-course RAWs selected from 29 accession-scoped RAWs; seven Ub-Proteome and seven Ub-IP files excluded. Every selected RAW appears exactly once.
biological_evidence: Publication Figure 1G and EV1G explicitly describes triplicate technical replicate samples across a 96-hour doxycycline induction time course of U2OS/shUb/HA-Ub(K27R)-c21 cells. Fifteen K27R file names map to 0,24,48,72,96-hour points, each with technical replicate 1-3. Biological replicate is set to 1 for this single documented cell-line experiment. U2OS provenance (osteosarcoma, tibia, female, 15Y) comes from Cellosaurus CVCL_0042, not experimental patient assignments. The three technical files per time point share one source name and carry technical replicate indices 1-3.
technical_evidence: PRIDE sample protocol states whole-proteome trypsin digestion, Q Exactive HF-X top-15 DDA, 300-1650 m/z, 1.4 m/z isolation, HCD 27 NCE. PRIDE structured instrument dropdown reports Q Exactive HF, but detailed protocol states HF-X.
reconciliation_note: Automated disease_on_control_runs flag is a false positive: WT means wild-type ubiquitin construct control, while osteosarcoma refers to the original U2OS cell-line origin, not an experimental disease-versus-healthy arm.
limitations: Seven Ub-Proteome and seven Ub-IP RAWs excluded because they form different study arms and cannot be confidently mapped to these time-course sources. No independent biological replication of this time course is claimed.
